Why clean your air ducts here

Life in Black Mountain Ranch is active. You head to trails at Miner’s Ridge, grab coffee near Paseo Del Sur, shuttle the kids to Del Norte High or Stone Ranch Elementary, and you’re in and out of the house all day. Every door opening pulls dust into your return grills. Add pet hair, cooking smoke, wildfire ash from past seasons, and pollen from chaparral, and your ductwork becomes a catch all.

Clean ducts can help with

  • Less dust on furniture and floors
  • Better airflow to rooms at the ends of long runs
  • Fewer musty or dusty smells when the system starts
  • Lower strain on your blower motor and coil
  • More consistent comfort across upstairs and downstairs

Is a guest room or loft always warmer or cooler than the rest of the home? That might be airflow, not your AC size. Cleaning and balancing can make a big difference.

Our air duct cleaning process

Clean ducts are about more than a quick vacuum at the vents. We follow a full system approach so the clean lasts.

1) System check and setup

  • Inspect supply and return trunks, registers, plenum, and blower compartment
  • Verify access panels and create service openings if needed, then seal them correctly at the end
  • Cover registers to control airflow during cleaning

2) Negative pressure and source removal

  • Connect a powerful negative air machine with HEPA filtration
  • Use rotary brushes and air whips to dislodge dust, lint, and debris
  • Pull waste into sealed containers for proper disposal

3) Return side and blower area

  • Clean return ducting and grills where dust collects fastest
  • Wipe and vacuum the blower compartment
  • Check the evaporator coil face and drain pan. If coil cleaning would help, we can add that service with your OK

4) Supply registers and grills

  • Remove and wash registers
  • Clean the duct near the opening where build up is common

5) Seal up and test

  • Seal access points and check for leakage
  • Run the system and confirm airflow

6) Optional services

  • Duct sanitizing for odors or microbes
  • Duct sealing for leakage
  • Airflow balancing adjustments

You’ll see before and after photos so you know exactly what changed.

Signs your ducts need cleaning

Not sure if it’s time? Look for

  • Dust puffs from vents when the system kicks on
  • Dark fuzz or lint on supply grills
  • Musty or smoky odors that won’t go away
  • A filter that clogs faster than normal
  • Allergy or asthma flare ups indoors
  • New home move in after a long vacancy
  • Remodels in Del Sur or Santaluz that left drywall dust everywhere
  • Rodents previously in the attic or crawlspace

Have you peeked behind a return grill lately? A quick look can tell you a lot.

Dryer vent cleaning and repair

Dryer vents do a lot of work in multi story homes around Black Mountain Ranch. Long vent runs snake through attics and out the roof. Lint build up makes cycles take longer, raises energy use, and can be a fire risk. Our team

  • Checks the vent hood for a stuck damper
  • Re routes vents that are too long or have too many turns
  • Installs booster fans when needed with Dryer Vent Booster Fan Installation
  • Repairs crushed or disconnected duct

If towels need two cycles or your dryer feels hot to the touch, it’s time to check the vent.

Energy savings without guessing

Energy waste hides in two places

  • Leaky duct joints that pull hot attic air into the system
  • Low airflow from clogged coils and filters, which makes the system run longer

We test for leakage and measure airflow to target the real problem. Fixing leaks at boots and trunks, sealing the air handler cabinet, and swapping a poor filter rack can reduce runtime and cut dust.

Commercial comfort that lasts all day

Restaurants, gyms, and offices often fight heat load from people and equipment. We help with

  • Correct outside air intake to keep CO2 levels in check
  • Better zoning to split open areas from private offices or kitchens
  • Controls that stop short cycling
  • Filter upgrades that capture more without starving air

Is your rooftop unit short cycling or tripping on high pressure during hot afternoons? We can inspect coils, check charge, and clear condenser fins so you get steady cooling through the evening rush.

We keep it clean while we clean

Nobody wants a messy cleanup after the cleaners. Our job ends with your space tidy

  • HEPA machines run while we work
  • Registers are washed outside or in a protected area
  • Access holes are sealed tight with proper fittings and code approved materials
  • We vacuum our path out the door

If we moved a piece of furniture, it goes back where it started.

Why many neighbors choose duct cleaning before replacing equipment

You may not need a new system to feel a real change. Dirty ducts and a dusty coil can chop 20 percent or more off your airflow. Cleaning the path your air takes can

  • Restore airflow room to room
  • Reduce noise at vents
  • Cut the musty smell on startup
  • Help your existing AC or heat pump keep up on hot days

If your system is aging or undersized, we’ll tell you. If it has years left, we’ll help you get those years.

Planning a remodel or addition

Adding a loft, moving walls, or finishing a bonus room? Let’s make sure airflow keeps up. We can

  • Inspect the current duct layout
  • Add or resize runs to new spaces
  • Update returns to avoid whistling and dust buildup
  • Set up zoning for better control upstairs vs downstairs
  • Upgrade insulation and attic ventilation while the space is open

This avoids hot corners and cold spots that are tough to fix later.

Helpful tips between cleanings

Want to keep your ducts cleaner longer?

  • Change filters on time. If you can’t remember, set a reminder on your phone
  • Keep return grills clear of furniture and curtains
  • Vacuum floor registers when you do floors
  • Use kitchen and bath fans to pull moisture and odors out quickly
  • After a big dust event or wildfire smoke day, run the fan with a good filter for a while

If your filter looks dirty after one month every time, we can check for leakage pulling attic dust into returns.

How often should you clean ducts

Most homes in this area land between 3 to 5 years. You may need more often if

  • You have pets that shed
  • You had recent construction dust
  • Someone in the home has asthma or allergies
  • You run the system year round

Commercial spaces usually need annual inspections and cleaning on a set cycle based on hours of use.
